docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Toru Dutt (1856–1877) of Calcutta, who wrote in English and French and died at twenty-one, retold legends of the epics and Purāṇas in English ballad verse: Sāvitrī, Lakṣmaṇa, Jogādhya Umā, the royal ascetic and the hind, Dhruva, Buttoo (Ekalavya), Sindhu, Prahlāda and Sītā. Her father published them after her death, in 1882, with a few other poems and an introductory memoir by Edmund Gosse.
